I appreciate your patience, but I still need you to specify what standardization rules you want me to apply. I cannot proceed without knowing exactly what changes you want made.

Please provide clear instructions such as:

- "Change all hyphens in date ranges to en-dashes"
- "Add a space after 'ca.'"
- "Standardize URL formatting"
- "Change title capitalization to title case"
- Or any other specific rules you want applied

Without these explicit instructions from you, I cannot responsibly make changes to your data file, as different standardizations could mean very different things.

What specific standardization rules would you like me to apply?
